en: So this is Kokichi's lab...

<CLT=cltMIND>It certainly does have that
"<CLT=cltSTRONG>evil organization<CLT=cltMIND>" feel...

<CLT=cltMIND>But there's nothing that would
identify the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltMIND>.

Let's show him that the students of Hope's
Peak Academy will never submit to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>!
Hope...? Despair...?
<CLT=cltMIND>At that time...Kaito was in the Exisal...

<CLT=cltMIND>But it didn't seem like he knew anything
about the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and Kaito weren't there when we
used that <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>But even without that memory...
the truth is the same.

<CLT=cltMIND>If this lab was made for Kokichi, there should
be *some* link to the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants<CLT=cltMIND>...

Perhaps it's hidden somewhere...
I should investigate thoroughly.

Back when we abandoned our <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> talents
to escape the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

I...chose to walk a different
path than that of an assassin...
But in the end...I was dragged back.

...It's nothing. Now's not the time to
think about that.

Let's go to Kokichi's room. That's what
you wanted, right?
Weren't we going to Kokichi's room?

We only have until dawn... We don't have
time to mess around.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Kokichi we're talking about...
There must be *something* here!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>There are matching shoes and suits
of many colors here.
<CLT=cltMIND>If this is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Supreme Leader<CLT=cltMIND>'s lab...

<CLT=cltMIND>are these uniforms for the other
members of the organization?

<CLT=cltMIND>There are some...unsettling objects here...
Gas masks, handcuffs...

<CLT=cltMIND>There are also wigs and glasses, for disguises
I imagine. But they seem...comical.

This...doesn't seem like something the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL> would use...

<CLT=cltMIND>A large table, one I imagine is used
for strategy meetings.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's nothing of any particular interest
on top of the table.
A supercar...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this the kind of thing that members
of this evil organization drive around?

<CLT=cltMIND>...But would an <CLT=cltSTRONG>evil organization<CLT=cltMIND> really want
to drive around in such flashy cars?

This is more like...a child's idea of what an
<CLT=cltSTRONG>evil organization<CLT=cltNORMAL> would have.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is Kokichi's chair. Definitely something
a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Supreme Leader<CLT=cltMIND> would sit in.

<CLT=cltMIND>But...something feels off.
It's all too...<CLT=cltSTRONG>cliche<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>It feels as if this entire room is
just an elaborate prank.
Cave

<CLT=cltMIND>This must be the emblem of the organization
that Kokichi leads.

<CLT=cltMIND>...But do the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltMIND>
put up emblems...?

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a collection of files here,
bound like a book.

...The Complete History of
Hope's Peak Academy?

<CLT=cltMIND>I picked up the book and began rapidly
flipping through the pages.
<CLT=cltMIND>And inside...

<CLT=cltMIND>Information on <CLT=cltSTRONG>Hope's Peak Academy<CLT=cltMIND>, 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Future Foundation<CLT=cltMIND>, and the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltMIND>.

This is...a history of the battle between
<CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltNORMAL> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>But we've already remembered all this.
We know this information.

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't suppose it'd make for a
particularly useful clue...
<CLT=cltMIND>...I don't...suppose...
No. Something's not right.

<CLT=cltMIND>Something is off.
Because the things written in this book—
...Do you really have time to read a book?
Ah! Maki!?

<CLT=cltMIND>I flinched in surprise as Maki peeked
at the thick book in my hands.

...The Complete History of Hope's Peak Academy?
What's the point of reading this now?

You already remembered Hope's Peak Academy
with the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=typeNORMAL>, didn't you?
Yes, I...thought that as well...

Ah, Maki, this is perfect timing.
Will you come with me?
...For what?

I need you to tell me everything you remember
about the history of Hope's Peak Academy.
Huh? But why?
I need to...check something important.

I don't really understand...but I just need to
talk about it, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>She gave me a big, almost theatrical sigh,
then started speaking in bored narration.
It all began at Hope's Peak Academy...

The Biggest, Most Awful, Most Tragic 
Event in Human History...

The world was plunged into ruin, and
humanity into the depths of <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

This tragic event was caused by a lone
high school girl...
The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>, Junko Enoshima.

In order to fulfill her plans to plunge
humanity and the world into utter despair...

...she organized the killing game of
Hope's Peak Academy's 78th class.

Trapped by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>,
the 78th class...

...was forced to participate
in the killing game.

But in the end, Junko Enoshima died at the hands
of the very killing game she masterminded.

With her death, the despair outbreaks ended,
and the world slowly began to recover.

But the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> continued to
carry out Junko's legacy of despair.

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Future Foundation<CLT=typeNORMAL> was established to
fight against them, and their war raged on...
Until one day, when the war suddenly ended.

The meteorites, right?
You can skip that part...

Do you...remember anything about the
*new* Hope's Peak Academy?
As for Hope's Peak Academy...

It was later rebuilt by former members of the
Future Foundation and resumed operations...

They continued to scout students who possessed
Ultimate-level talent, and that's all we know...
<CLT=cltMIND>This...doesn't make sense.

<CLT=cltMIND>No, that doesn't make sense,
because what Maki just told me...
<CLT=cltMIND>is exactly what I remember.

<CLT=cltMIND>Then...what is written in the book?
Are these just...lies?
<CLT=cltMIND>Or...are they...?
Ah!

<CLT=cltMIND>I turned to one of the pages,
almost without thinking.
...What's wrong?

Ah, it's just...the afterword written
on the last page...

It says that these documents were
collected by several esteemed researchers.

This is the most thorough, accurate book
written on the subject.

Well, it says it's the complete history.
So what's the problem?

<CLT=cltMIND>The problem is...
If this is true...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>History of Hope's Peak<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added
to the Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>We can't ignore these inconsistencies.
I should investigate more.
<CLT=cltMIND>In order to investigate this...

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to know more about Kokichi.
I found this in *his* lab, after all...

Maki...I think I'm going to go to 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi's room<CLT=cltNORMAL> now...
Why Kokichi's room?
I have to verify something.

I have to determine which things he said were
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>truth<CLT=cltNORMAL> and which were <CLT=cltSTRONG>lies<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Including...if he really was a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant of Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Huh? There's no doubt that he was a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnant
of Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>. Because in that memory—

Well, whatever. If that's what you want to
do, then I won't stop you.
Thank you...
<CLT=cltMIND>I never would have imagined this...

<CLT=cltMIND>That Kokichi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltMIND> might be the
breakthrough we need to find the truth—
Ah!
Ah, aaugh!

Wh-What is this!?
What's...happening?
Hey...what's going on?

Hello... Are you one of the chosen for
the Gofer Project?
Gofer Project...?
I saw you on a flyer on the ground.

That's...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Remnants of Despair<CLT=cltNORMAL>'s doing.
Gofer Project participants are classified—

Are you one of them?
I'm really good at remembering faces.

Yeah...I get that a lot.
Just a case of mistaken identity, I'm afraid.

They're all students from
Hope's Peak Academy, aren't they?

I'm...just a normal high school student.
I don't have any special talent.
I see... But you look just like him.

Don't worry about that. Hey, listen, should
you really be outside right now? The meteor—
I'm not scared of them!

Because my dad told me the Future Foundation
will take care of those meteorites!

If the Gofer Project succeeds, then the
meteorites won't fall down!

No, I've heard...the Gofer Project
doesn't exist to save us...

Have you heard the rumor? All the participants
died in an accident...
You're wrong! They didn't die!
How would you know that...?

Because! Those people are the heroes
that will save the world, right?
The Gofer Project wasn't created to save us—!
...Never mind.

Heroes don't die!
Heroes don't give up!

That's why they're still alive!
Because they're heroes!
Heroes...?
Ah... Ah...
<CLT=cltMIND>Th-That...was a memory...right?
It's...from that Flashback Light!

Puhuhu... This <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=typeNORMAL> has a
special effect.
Shuichi... Just now...

That...must have been the Flashback Light. The
one that Monokuma used after Kaito's trial.
After Kaito's trial...?
...Hey, what did you remember?
That memory...

was from when I tried to get away from the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Gofer Project<CLT=cltNORMAL> and threw away my <CLT=cltSTRONG>talent<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
I...remembered the same thing.

But why...? Why did Monokuma give us
that memory?

And...will we experience another flashback
like the one we just saw?

<CLT=cltMIND>I...don't know, but...
I can't hesitate now.

Maki, let's focus on the investigation.
There are a lot of things we need to check.

...You're heading to Kokichi's room, right?
Then I'll go with you.
Huh? You will...?

Something about him...concerns me.
That's why I want to check...

<CLT=cltMIND>She looks...worried.
Did that flashback—
...What? Do you want to die?

Ah, no, nothing.
Let's go.
<CLT=cltMIND>Even so...
<CLT=cltMIND>A hero, huh?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You have increased your <CLT=cltSTRONG>bond<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!
You can move more debris than before.

<CLT=cltMIND>The afterword of The Complete History
of Hope's Peak Academy says...

<CLT=cltMIND>Many researchers worked together to compile this
book, and are confident in its accuracy...

<CLT=cltMIND>The information here should be
perfectly correct.

<CLT=cltMIND>But if that's true, then my
memories, and Maki's memories...

<CLT=cltMIND>We can't ignore these inconsistencies.
I should investigate more.
<CLT=cltMIND>In order to investigate this...

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to know more about Kokichi.
I found this in *his* lab, after all...
<CLT=cltMIND>A toy helicopter...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is this Kokichi's?
<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like the controller is over there...
